canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C. denied {value} of its 3,140 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C. decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C. will deny any specific future application with 4.0% probability
Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C. is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C. discriminates or violates law
4.0% applies to Velocio Mortgage, L.L.C.'s non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
